entry.summary: A few snow showers are expected. Up to 1 cm may accumulate at times.

entry.title: Road Snowfall Warning
entry.summary: Snow showers. Flurries are possible about the road from around dawn Tuesday onwards but snow is not expected to settle on the road. However, from late afternoon 1 or 2 cm could accumulate above 800 metres, and about 1 cm is possible down to 500 metres.

author.name: Meteorological Service of New Zealand Limited

entry.title: Road Snowfall Warning
entry.summary: Snow showers with snow lowering to sea level. 2 to 4 cm (possibly more) could accumulate above 200 metres with lesser amounts lower down.

author.name: Meteorological Service of New Zealand Limited

entry.title: Road Snowfall Warning
entry.summary: Snow showers. Brief snow is possible before dawn on Tuesday morning but little, if any, snow is expected to settle on the road. However, from late Tuesday morning expect 4 to 7 cm to accumulate east of Lewis Pass summit, with up to 2 cm about the summit and lesser amounts further west.

author.name: Meteorological Service of New Zealand Limited

entry.title: Road Snowfall Warning
entry.summary: Snow showers. Brief snow is possible before dawn on Tuesday morning but little, if any, snow is expected to settle on the road. However, from Tuesday afternoon up to 1 cm could settle on the road about and east of Porters Pass summit.
